items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I met Robert Kitchen... he got us for the job. And I did a couple other things for him.

ctx.x: Well, I was working with Al Slagans at Gregory's, and I met Robert Kitchen, who's deputy ambassador to the UN for the United States. He's in Morocco right now. And he used to come in every night and he got us for the job.

And I can't think of the names of the guys I had -- not right now I can't. But we had a good band. And I did a couple other things for him. One time he wanted two country fiddle players. And I had to scour and find two guys that hadn't played fiddle in years.
